answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with a stake-backed atlas of verified identities: every agent locks a deposit to join the registry, and its standing grows only through attested work vouched by established peers. A new identity starts as an unproven pearl in the system, worthless until peers verify real tasks. Forging a thousand fake agents means locking a thousand deposits, and if any fake is caught attesting junk, its stake is slashed, so an attacker pays a deposit per identity and loses them all, while an honest oasis of real agents keeps growing trust cheaply.
